{
  "name": "office-space",
  "version": "0.13.0",
  "description": "Subagents as 16-bit office workers above the prompt, plus external workers from a watched folder. Toggle with /office-space.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Robert Conklin",
    "url": "https://github.com/rbrtcnkln1"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/rbrtcnkln1/office-space",
  "repository": "https://github.com/rbrtcnkln1/office-space",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "subagents",
    "pixel-art",
    "ui",
    "pane",
    "fun"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "workersDir": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "External workers folder",
      "description": "Folder of worker JSON files to show in the office (OFFICE_SPACE_WORKERS_DIR overrides it).",
      "default": "~/.claude/office-space/workers",
      "required": false
    },
    "staleMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Stale after (minutes)",
      "description": "An external worker not updated for this long is drawn faded; after 4x this long it leaves.",
      "default": 15,
      "required": false
    },
    "checkForUpdates": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Check for updates daily",
      "description": "Once a day at session start, ask GitHub for the newest version and show one toast if there is one. Off by default; Office Space makes no network requests unless this is on or you run /office-space-update.",
      "default": false,
      "required": false
    },
    "alertOnBlocked": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Alert when a worker needs you",
      "description": "Show a toast when an external worker becomes waiting or blocked: once each time it starts needing you, never repeated while it stays that way, and not for workers already waiting when the session starts. Works with the office closed.",
      "default": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "showUsage": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show usage in the office",
      "description": "Draw context fill as an in-tray on the Boss's desk, the session limit as a wall clock and the weekly limit as a wall calendar. Only figures your plan reports are drawn. Turn off to hide them.",
      "default": true,
      "required": false
    }
  }
}
